description: This file contains the implementation of the CustomerService interface, providing business logic for customer management. It includes methods for retrieving, saving, updating, and deleting customer data, as well as fetching customer addresses via geolocation.

classes.name: CustomerServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of CustomerService, providing customer data management functions such as retrieval, creation, updating, and deletion.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves a list of customers matching the given first name.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a customer by their unique identifier.

methods.name: getByNick
methods.description: Retrieves a customer by their nickname.

methods.name: getByNick (overloaded)
methods.description: Retrieves a customer by nickname within the context of a specific store.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of customers associated with a specific store.

methods.name: listByStore (overloaded)
methods.description: Retrieves a list of customers based on store and filtering criteria.

methods.name: getCustomerAddress
methods.description: Uses geolocation to retrieve the customer's address based on IP address.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Creates or updates a customer record.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a customer and associated attributes.
